fun submitDraft() {
        if (!canPublish) return
        onSubmit(
            DynamicPublishDraft(
                text = text,
                title = title,
                imageUris = imageUris,
                voteId = vote?.voteId ?: 0L,
                voteTitle = vote?.title.orEmpty(),
                reserveId = reserve?.reserveId ?: 0L,
                private = privatePublish,
                mentions = mentions,
                emotes = emotes,
                topic = topic,
                existingImages = initialDraft.existingImages.filter { it.img_src in imageUris },
            )
        )
    }
